controls.label: Visible color
controls.qualification: NASA Blue Marble Next Generation July 2004, cloud-free global surface mosaic. Deep ocean is shaded from depth, taken from NASA's bathymetry edition of the same month where the plain edition carries its arbitrary constant fill; shallow and coastal water stays observed.

controls.label: Cloud coverage
controls.qualification: Archival NASA Blue Marble cloud composite over July 2004 surface imagery; not live weather. Deep ocean is shaded from depth, taken from NASA's bathymetry edition of the same month where the plain edition carries its arbitrary constant fill.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.qualification: GEBCO_2026 terrain model. Colors show meters above and below mean sea level; relief is shaded for readability. Ocean depths combine measured and estimated terrain. Land includes the ice surface.

controls.label: Night lights
controls.qualification: NASA Black Marble · 2025 annual snow-free radiance. Warm false color shows upward nighttime light on a logarithmic scale. Gray: missing data or outside 75°N–65°S coverage. This is an annual observation, not live lighting.

controls.label: ENSO
controls.qualification: NASA MUR · 1 km source imagery · 7 Sept 2026. Sea-surface temperature departure from the 2003–2014 average. NASA colors saturate below −3 and at +3 °C. Gray: land, ice, or unavailable imagery.

controls.label: Cross section
controls.qualification: Schematic interior based on NASA Science. Layer boundaries and colors illustrate the model; this is not direct interior imaging.

controls.label: Mantle tomography
controls.qualification: GLAD-M35 (2024) seismic model. Mantle colors show slower and faster vertically polarized shear waves relative to the global mean at the same depth. Crust and core are schematic.

provenance.normal: NASA Blue Marble Next Generation July 2004
provenance.topography: GEBCO_2026 terrain model: signed heights relative to mean sea level, with prepared hypsometric color and cartographic relief
provenance.nightLights: NASA Black Marble VJ146A4 Collection 2 · 2025 AllAngle_Composite_Snow_Free radiance; public GeoTIFF mosaic by Jurij Stare, lightpollutionmap.info
provenance.mantleTomography: Cui et al. (2024), GLAD-M35 r0.1 via EarthScope EMC
provenance.clouds: NASA Blue Marble archival clouds over the July 2004 visible-color mosaic
